_description: Cash interest correctly flows into NIIT investment-income base. Pension drives MAGI above NIIT threshold while cash interest is the only investment income — verifies the proxy extension (withdrawalFromBrokerage + cashInterest).
_rationale: Single filer, NIIT threshold $200k. Pension $300k/yr (ordinary, NOT investment income). Cash $5M @ 4% yield → $200k/yr ordinary income via cashInterest. No Taxable account → withdrawalFromBrokerage = 0. Spending fully covered by pension surplus (cash interest is reinvested in the cash balance, not separately spent). MAGI = otherTaxableGross + ssTaxable + fromBrokerage = $500k + 0 + $0 = $500k. NIIT excess = $300k. Investment income proxy = fromBrokerage + cashInterest = $0 + $200k = $200k. NIIT base = min($200k, $300k) = $200k. niitTax = 3.8% × $200k = $7,600. Without the proxy extension this would be 0 (since fromBrokerage = 0). Florida zero state tax, 0% inflation, 0% growth volatility.
name: Cash Interest MAGI
